join.step3: Find the server in the list: {name}
join.tip: Shows how to join in the game.
news.olderTip: Gets the next 20 posts of each Exchange site.
news.noMatch: No news match the search or the period.
host.title: My servers
host.sub: Host a server on this PC for friends or for everyone.
host.emptyText: TM Horizon downloads the official dedicated server and sets it up for you.
host.editRunning: Stop the server to edit it.
host.deleteText: Its folder, settings and saved passwords are removed.
host.experimentalHelp: Set up from the server's own files, never run on a real server yet. Tell me if it works.
host.engineText.plain: Nadeo's server with your maps and settings. Players, lists and bans from here.
host.engineText.randomizer: Random TMX maps: only unfinished ones (100% TMX) or all maps of a genre such as Tech or Fullspeed. Starts by itself; in chat, players skip, vote for a preset or load a map by TMX ID.
host.engineText.xaseco: Records, Dedimania online records and chat commands.
host.xasecoBlocked: Not available: XAseco 1.16 needs PHP 5, which gets no security fixes since 2018. A maintained replacement with Dedimania is planned.
host.randomizerLicence: 100% TMX server by cheatoskar, AGPL-3.0, source: github.com/cheatoskar/100-TMX-Server (in game: /source).
host.banText: {login} is kicked and put on the black list. You can remove the login under Lists.
host.guestsHint: These players always get in, even when the server is full or has a password.
host.adminsHint: Logins you trust. Kept for a controller; the plain server has no in-game admin commands.
host.lanOnly: This server is LAN only. Switch it to Internet under Edit.
host.needHub: Turn on the TM Horizon Hub in Settings for the test.
host.accountHelpTmf: Use a separate account for the server, not the one you play with (one account can only be online once). Enter its login and password below.
host.accountHelpNew: Create a dedicated server login on the official page (you need your game account there), then enter login and password below.
host.accountMissing: No account saved yet (Edit, step Internet).
host.upnpFail: UPnP did not work: {detail}. Open the ports in your router by hand.
host.upnpAtStart: Opened by UPnP when the server starts.
host.upnpOff: UPnP is off. Forward TCP and UDP {game} and {p2p} to this PC in your router.
host.neverXmlrpc: Never forward {port} (remote control). It stays on this PC.
host.firewallHelp: Needs admin rights once. Allow runs this command; Windows asks you to confirm.
host.testHelp: The TM Horizon Hub connects back to your address on the game port. Only to you, nothing else.
host.reach.cgnat: Not reachable. Your provider probably shares one public address between customers (CGNAT); port forwarding cannot work. Ask for a public IPv4 or use a VPS.
host.reach.router: Not reachable. The router refused the port mapping. Forward the ports by hand.
host.reach.firewall: Not reachable although the router ports are open. Check the Windows Firewall step.
host.reach.upnp-off: Not reachable. UPnP is off: forward the ports in your router, or turn UPnP on.
host.reach.hub: The test could not reach the TM Horizon Hub.
host.udpNote: The test checks TCP. UDP is confirmed when a friend joins.
host.listHelp: Show your server in the TM Horizon server list. An admin checks it first.
host.consent: I agree that my public IP address and the server name are shown publicly.
host.contactHint: Only admins see the contact, to send you the token.
host.submitted: Submitted. You get a token once it is approved.
host.tokenHelp: Paste the token (tmhs_…) here; then the launcher sends name, players and map every 5 minutes while the server runs.
host.tokenSaved: Token saved. Name, players and map go to the hub every 5 minutes.
host.wiz.name: Name
host.name: Server name
host.lanHelp: Only players in your home network. No account and no router setup needed.
host.internetHelp: Everyone over the internet. Needs a server account and open ports.
host.portsHelp: Picked free on this PC. Start the server before the game, or the game takes 2350.
host.noLocalMaps: No maps in your Tracks folder. Use Files… or TMX.
host.randomizerMaps: The maps come from TMX, picked at random. Unfinished maps or all maps of a genre; players can switch by vote in game.
host.loginCheckLater: Checked on the first internet start: the server reports its login in the test above.
host.passwordStore: Passwords are kept in the Windows Credential Manager, never in logs.
host.upnpHelp: Only {game} and {p2p}, removed when the server stops.
host.autostart: Start when I log in to Windows
host.autostartHelp: TM Horizon starts hidden in the tray and starts this server. No admin rights.
host.closeText: {n} server(s) still running. Keep them running in the background?
host.err.engine: This engine is not available for this game.
host.err.name: Enter a name.
host.err.portsTaken: Another of your servers uses these ports.
host.err.portBusy: A port is in use on this PC (is the game running?). Start the server first or change the ports.
host.err.login: A login in the lists is not valid.
host.err.serverLogin: The server login is not valid.
host.err.needLogin: Enter the server login and password (step Internet).
host.err.noPackage: The server download for this game is not available yet.
host.err.leftover: A process from last time still runs. Stop or keep it first.
host.err.exited: The server closed right away. See Log.
host.err.noAnswer: The server did not answer within 3 minutes. See Log.
host.err.consent: Agree to the public listing first.
host.err.listGame: The hub list has no entries for this game yet.
host.err.notReachable: The server is not reachable from outside, so it cannot be listed.
host.err.tmxIdOnly: Search is not available for this TMX site; enter the map id.
host.err.token: That is not a hub token (tmhs_…).
host.err.tooOften: Too many tests. Try again in an hour.
randomizer.noRelease: No download of the 100% TMX server yet (no GitHub release).
hostfmt.warn.bad-color: Colour code with fewer than 3 digits
hostfmt.warn.trailing-dollar: Lone $ at the end is dropped
hostfmt.tip.color: Pick any colour. It is rounded to 3 hex digits.
hostfmt.tip.link: Link. Put the address in the brackets.

cb.askText: For TMX search and notifications in the game.
perf.title: Performance
perf.win.title: Windows settings for the game
perf.fso.tip: Sets the compatibility flag for this exe. Can reduce input lag and stutter.
perf.dpi.tip: Windows does not scale the game window.
perf.gpu.tip: Uses the fast graphics card on laptops with two.
perf.cfg.title: Game graphics config
perf.cfg.readOnly: This file is shown read only.
perf.cfg.untested: Writing this file is not tested in the game yet. The original is kept for Undo.
perf.cfg.backup: The original file is copied first. Close the game before.
perf.tip.vsync: V-Sync is on. Turn it off if you use a frame limiter.
perf.tip.aa: Antialiasing is on. Turn it off with TM Vibrant Shaders.
perf.tip.fullscreen: Borderless windowed switches faster between windows.
perf.bench.title: Benchmark
perf.bench.needHost: Needs Horizon Client in this game.
perf.bench.label: Label
perf.bench.tip: Starts the game. From the main menu the test runs by itself; for a replay, open it yourself.
perf.rep.title: Replay archive
perf.watch.title: Record start
perf.watch.tip: Watches the game for 120 s after it starts from here. Changes nothing in the game.
perf.dxvk.title: DXVK (Vulkan)
perf.dxvk.untested: Writing d3d9.dll is not tested in the game yet. Switching off removes the files again.
perf.dxvk.note: Draws the image through Vulkan instead of Direct3D 9. Changes only how it is drawn.
perf.dxvk.download: DXVK {v} is downloaded (SHA-256 checked) and copied to the game folder.
perf.dxvk.cached: DXVK {v} is already cached and is copied to the game folder.
perf.dxvk.err.running: The game is running. Close it first.
perf.dxvk.err.notWritable: The game folder is not writable (Program Files needs administrator rights).
perf.dxvk.err.foreignDll: A d3d9.dll is already in the game folder (for example TM Vibrant Shaders). DXVK can't run behind it: remove that mod first.
perf.dxvk.err.foreignConf: The game folder already has a dxvk.conf that the launcher did not write.
perf.dxvk.err.hash: The archive does not have the expected checksum. Nothing written.
